name: Pole test
description: The animal is placed head-up at the top of a vertical pole and must turn and climb down to the base. Measures bradykinesia and motor coordination, often in Parkinson's disease models.

parameters.label: Pole length
parameters.help: Length of the pole from the top, where the animal is placed, down to the base.

parameters.label: Trial cut-off
parameters.help: Longest time a trial may last before it is stopped.

inputEvents.label: Turn completed
inputEvents.definition: The subject has turned to face downward.

inputEvents.label: Fall
inputEvents.definition: The subject falls off the pole.

events.label: Base reached
events.definition: Scored arrival at the base, passed through.

metrics.label: Time to turn
metrics.description: Time the animal needed to turn head-down. Longer times suggest slowed movement.
metrics.definition: Time of the turn_complete event from the trial start.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NOT_SCORED) when the event was not scored and (EVENT_NOT_OBSERVED) when it did not occur.

metrics.label: Total time
metrics.description: Time from the trial start until the animal reached the base.
metrics.definition: Time of the base_reached event from the trial start. No cut-off value is imputed.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NOT_SCORED) when the event was not scored and (EVENT_NOT_OBSERVED) when it did not occur.

metrics.label: Descent time
metrics.description: Time from completing the turn to reaching the base.
metrics.definition: Time from completing the turn to reaching the base.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing with the reason of the first missing event.

metrics.label: Descent speed
metrics.description: Pole length divided by the descent time. Lower speeds suggest impaired motor function.
metrics.definition: Pole length divided by the descent time.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (ZERO_DENOMINATOR) when the descent time is 0; otherwise missing with the reason of descent_time_s.

metrics.label: Fall detected
metrics.description: Whether the animal fell off the pole.
metrics.definition: 1 when a fall was scored, 0 when falls were scored and none occurred.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NOT_SCORED) when falls were not scored.
